tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Urban Land Transport BMTC TTMC B Block Kengal Hanumanthaiah Road, Shanti Nagar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The average annual financial turnover of the Bidder as per the audited financial statement of last 3 years, ending 31st March 2026, should be at least Rs. 300 Lakhs.
Bidder should have a positive net worth in past 3 years, ending 31st March 2026
Consultant should be registered with Sales Tax/ Income Tax Department of Government of India.
Bidder should be a firm/Company registered in India under the Companies Act 2013 or under LLP Act 2008 and operational at least for the last 5 years.
Bidder should not be blacklisted/banned by any government/semi-government authority in India for the supply of materials/carrying out operations and maintenance work/application development.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in preparation of techno-economic feasibility studies for rail-based urban transit system like LRT/metro/suburban rail (each study involving not less than 15 km network) in India in the last 10 years.
Specific experience in preparation of techno-economic feasibility studies of rail-based modern TRAM System (of minimum 10 km length each) in the last 8 years.
Study methodology. Approach for conducting a techno economic study for transitioning from the existing BRTS system to a rail track based modern tram system.Plese see tender document for more details.
Understanding of existing context, BRTS operations, site conditions, key opportunities and challenges.
Team composition. Refer tender document for details
